notes.title: Inventory, bug fixes
notes.content:
Inventory added. Selected items (keys, first-aid kits, cartridges) are now added to inventory through Raycast (by hovering over an item).
Now Sonya can use weapons from the first level. When she arrives in the house, she can use the ladle from the table as a weapon and fight off the infected ones. The ladle is quite massive. ;) It looks funny.
Fixed the most noticeable bug in the first level caused by Occlusion Culling, which incorrectly rendered objects outside the camera's field of view.
Fixed a bug with some zombies. The operation of two identical scripts that caused a shutdown (disappearance) when approaching the player was eliminated
